# M015 — Tessellated PMI placement: third coordinate must be 0 in tessellated_geometric_set (repositioned form preferred)

## Description

For efficiency, tessellated annotation sets should be combined with `repositioned_tessellated_item` so that the `coordinates_list` entries have z=0 (annotation lies in its own 2D plane) and the placement axis carries the 3D position.

## Reproducer recipe

Tessellated annotation in plane at z=10. Either emit absolute 3D coords (z≈10 throughout), or use `repositioned_tessellated_item` with z=0 in coords plus an axis at z=10.

## Expected kernel behavior

writers prefer the repositioned form; readers must support both.
